objects.name: Elder Maren
objects.greeting: Welcome home, child. Oakhollow is small, but the Vale is wide.|The roads are not what they were. Bortzal at the mill, and worse in the marsh, they say.
objects.topics: The Vale=Brasswick lies east, past the mill. The Khorigale camp beyond it trades in everything.; The wood=Old pines and older stones. Bram the hunter keeps a cabin there.; Work=Garrick wants a word with you, and Odo has boars in his barley.

objects.name: Garrick
objects.greeting: Mind the sparks.|A blade is only as good as its edge. Keep whetstones on you.
objects.stock: sword, sword sharper, dagger, mace, battle_axe, longbow, whetstone x20, iron wedges x20, mace studs x20, arrow bundle x10, iron bar x10, upgrade ingot x3
objects.topics: The forge=My bench is yours to use. Bring iron and I will show you keys and hooks.; The mine=The Copperpit gate is locked. Hobb the miller had the key, last I heard.

objects.name: Tilda
objects.greeting: Herbs, tonics, hooks and twine. What ails you?
objects.stock: health potion x5, stamina potion x4, mana potion x3, empty bottle x12, sage x6, wild berries x10, twine x10, fish hook x10, willow rod x1, parchment x4
objects.topics: Brewing=A bottle, berries and sage in my cauldron makes a health potion. Try it.; Fishing=Fen down at Fisher's Rest sells better rods than mine.

objects.name: Farmer Odo
objects.greeting: If it is not the crows, it is the boars.

objects.name: Old Tam
objects.greeting: I saw the planet rise red once. Nothing good came of that year.

objects.name: Pip
objects.greeting: Are you going to fight the Bortzal? Can I come?

objects.title: A word with the smith
objects.offer: Garrick at the forge has been asking after you. Hear him out, then come and tell me what he wants.
objects.remind: Garrick's forge is east of the well.
objects.thanks: So he means to arm you. Good. You will need it on the road.

objects.title: Boars in the barley
objects.offer: Boars have been at my barley every night this week. Fell three of them and I will make it worth your while.
objects.remind: They root about the south-east corner, past the cabbages.
objects.thanks: That is three fewer. Here - and some leather, for the trouble.
objects.reward: coins x60, leather x4, roast meat x2

objects.title: Sage for the pot
objects.offer: I am out of sage, and my knees will not take the walk to the wood. Bring me three bunches?
objects.remind: Sage grows grey-green at the edge of the wood, west of here.
objects.thanks: That will do nicely. Take these - you will want them out there.
objects.reward: health potion x3, empty bottle x4, coins x15

objects.contents: coins x35, scroll of return, bilberries x4
